testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/plp/verify-compare-product-functionality.spec.ts > PLP - Verify Compare Product Functionality > verify compare product functionality

scenario.summary: Guest searches a simple, a configurable, a bundle and a second simple product and adds each to the product comparison list (checking the added and already-added messages), opens the compare page and checks the product names, tries a grouped product as the fifth (maximum-limit message), removes a product, checks Print and removes all. Nothing is added to the cart.
steps: Open the webstore as a guest (empty storageState; baseURL pinned to the at webstore in the spec).
Search the simple product SKU, check its name and SKU, add it to compare (added message); add it again (already-added message), remove it and add it again.
Search the configurable product SKU, check hdgProductName666 / divProductSKUContainer666 (name, 'SKU:<parent sku>') and add it to compare.
Search the bundle SKU, check its name and divProductSKUContainer142 ('SKU:<sku>') and add it to compare.
Search the second simple SKU, check name and SKU, add it to compare and open the comparison page.
On the comparison page check paraProductName484/666/142/392 show the four names.
Search the grouped SKU, check name and divProductSKUContainer408, add to compare: maximum-limit message expected; open the comparison page.
Remove product 484, go back, reopen the comparison page, check Print and remove all items.
stateChanges: Guest product-comparison list (session) filled with four products, then emptied by Remove All
assertions: Search results show each product's name and SKU.
Compare popup shows the added message, and the already-added message for a repeat.
Comparison page lists the names of the compared products; Print button visible.
Fifth product shows the maximum-limit message (conditional: soft fallback on the known QA compare rollback).
evidence: Title 'verify compare product functionality' and the ten step labels match the flow; guest storageState; no linked AIO cases.

Profile (atstage 2026-11-01): z-2430008 FOUND active SimpleProduct (MilwaukeeTool), inventory 250, storefrontProductIndex 1, but requiredAddOnCount 1 (PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK needs 0, so the recorded product may not pass as preferred); B-100000 FOUND active ConfigurableProduct (Philips), no own inventory, storefront index 1; z-1234579 FOUND active BundleProduct, inventory 28362; z-2100025 FOUND active SimpleProduct (Campbell), inventory 1000, but storefrontProductIndex 0 and requiredAddOnCount 1 (fails PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK as preferred); z-2200003 FOUND active GroupedProduct, inventory 250. 'SKU:B-100000' and 'SKU:z-1234579' are the SKU container texts (prefix + SKU), NOT_FOUND as SKUs.

Keys: nothing is added to the cart, so quantityUsed 1 and no add-ons or personalization (minAddOns 0, minPersonalizableAttributes 0). PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_WITH_VARIANTS minVariants 1 and variantAttributes BulbSize,Color,Technology as in the approved checkout entries for B-100000 (the test picks no variant). simple and otherSimple must be two different products (both PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK).

Product ids now come from outputs: simple.productId (484: the productName(484) and removeProductById(484) arguments map to it), configurable.parentProductId (666), bundle.productId (142), otherSimple.productId (392) and grouped.productId (408); the test ids built from them (hdgProductName666, divProductSKUContainer666/142/408, paraProductName<id>) stay config. Composed values stay data without output, built by the spec: parentProductSKU 'SKU:' + configurable.parentProductSku, bundleProductSKU1 'SKU:' + bundle.sku.

STORE_WEBSTORE_PRODUCT_COMPARE_ENABLED (pending) now covers the compare switch: need compare {store} (Enable Product Comparison on the store). Not covered: the compare limit of 4 (the fifth product, grouped, gets the maximum-limit message) is a webstore constant, so no key produces it; the test keeps adding exactly four products before the grouped one.
compareMessage and validationForAlreadyAddedProduct are fixed UI messages: expected-output.

Data in code: product ids 484, 666, 142, 392 and 408 in test ids (hdgProductName666, divProductSKUContainer666/142/408), compareProductPage.productName(484/666/142/392) and removeProductById(484); the literal '484' at line 122 is the productName(484) argument; the spec comment lists the product names.
migrate: the spec imports the JSON directly (import data from ...json), not through loadData (swap rule 1), and product ids are in the spec code (swap rule 4).
